thesis: Present profitability supports the operating case, while neither advocate resolves fab cash returns, geographic compensation or current valuation. A surprise catalyst is not required, but high net margin is not a through-cycle return on capacity. Neutral separates those truths from an extended immediate entry.
strongest_counterexample: Issuer-quarter net income NT$706.56bn on revenue NT$1,270.38bn gives55.62% derived net margin, demonstrating substantial realised profitability alongside a strong trend.
invalidation_conditions: A matched fab investment/debt cash bridge demonstrates positive post-investment surplus and positive overseas capacity returns, resolving the principal return gate without eliminating geographic exposure.
A subsequent comparable quarterly net-income result at or below zero would invalidate the retained substantial-profitability premise.
evidence_gaps: Debt, FCF, capex and overseas capacity returns.
Matched intrinsic valuation and through-cycle economics.
decisive_factors: Current quarter levels do not establish an incremental growth surprise.
NT$7 ordinary-share dividend differs from US$4.31 ADR EPS.
35.31x vendor reference and RSI87.9793 do not establish downside compensation.
